@copilot Remove the additional reflective class-loader test instrumentation/hbase/hbase-client-common-1.0/javaagent-unit-tests/src/indyTest/java/org/apache/hadoop/hbase/ipc/OpenTelemetryCallUtilIndyTest.java and the two sourceSets.test blocks adding src/indyTest/java in instrumentation/hbase/hbase-client-1.4/javaagent/build.gradle.kts and instrumentation/hbase/hbase-client-2.0/javaagent/build.gradle.kts. Existing HbaseClient14Test and HbaseClient20Test exercise the real agent-backed request/completion path, the 2.0 integration tests assert network-peer attributes, and the existing helper unit tests cover state identity, peer updates, and cleanup. Keep those existing integration and helper tests unchanged; do not add a replacement class-loader test, source set, or abstraction.

Keep the current simpler production implementation intact, including the application-injected org.apache.hadoop.hbase.ipc.OpenTelemetryCallUtil, exposed RequestAndContext and HbaseRequest, and the explanatory comments added in d610129375f. The earlier dynamic-carrier isolated-helper request was explicitly rejected by the user and reverted in f5c450efc38; do not reapply it. Scope this update to deleting the redundant test and its wiring, with any necessary correction to the PR description's now-stale claim about added helper-placement coverage. Preserve the PR template and draft state, and leave unrelated code unchanged.
